thread.title_full: 'Heil Hitler' shout, Nazi salute disrupt Coventry Town Council meeting - NewsBreak

author: Michael Walsh
title: 'Heil Hitler' shout, Nazi salute disrupt Coventry Town Council meeting - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Walsh ,
7 hours ago The April 20 Coventry Town Council meeting was interrupted by a man shouting "Heil Hitler" and performing a Nazi salute. (Journal Inquirer File Photo) COVENTRY — A person in the audience of Monday’s Town Council meeting said “Heil Hitler” and gave a Nazi salute as the meeting went into recess, officials said.
The incident followed public comment regarding the Town Council’s recent approval of an ordinance regulating home gun ranges in town that voters then overturned at a special meeting.
Lisa Thomas, the chair of the council, said the incident occurred as they asked John French — the chair of Coventry’s Republican Town Committee — to wrap up his public comment.
The incident was captured in a video recording of the meeting that is posted on the town’s website .
“If members of the audience shout out, shout expletives or 'Heil Hitler' me, you will be removed,” Thomas said when the meeting was called back into action.
A voice in the audience responded, saying “I can’t say Hitler?'”
Thomas said the same man also directed expletives at her earlier in the meeting and that they are aware of the identity of the man. Thomas said police were called due to the outbursts and an incident report was filed with the police, but that she declined to have the man removed as police presence remained throughout the rest of the meeting.
“I was weighing a lot of safety factors in a riled up room with some people potentially carrying guns,” Thomas told CT Insider.
Coventry police on Wednesday did not immediately respond to a request for more information about the incident, or whether it is under investigation.
